description_audit.note: Key correspondence, not correctness or runtime test. Reviews reflect pre-fix baseline; see pending changes.

lexical_inventory.note: Lexical records may contain duplicates, fragments, false positives and already translated strings.

linux_console_build.limits: Official 0.34.1 source with translated C++ overlay; Windows Tiles, localized DB data load and runtime Korean rendering not tested.

description_audit_after_fix.note: 8 Korean entries updated; remaining reference warning HINT_SEEN_BRANCH. Duplicates are in English reference files.

candidate_triage.note: Priority queue is heuristic; not confirmed untranslated count, not a completion percentage.

p0_output_callsites.note: Direct literal callsite heuristics only. English review candidates were 202 at first audit and 46 at final PR4 audit. Not complete untranslated count or game translation rate.

gameplay_database_audit.notes: The parser now follows source/database.cc and treats %%%%% as a valid delimiter. Some top-level originals already contain Korean. Keyword/line metrics do not measure game-wide translation quality.

monspell_korean_translation.note: 59.5% key correspondence only, not % of strings/game features translated. Aliases and __NONE keys may require no new rendered translation.

current_qa_work.edits: 8 Korean description entries corrected and verified by automated structural audit; contextual/runtime checks remain pending.
current_qa_work.remaining_known_pre_fix: Baseline before fixes: 5 reference-count reviews and 4 Lua reviews. Latest audit: 1 reference-count review, 0 Lua reviews, 3 original English duplicate keys, 260 extra Korean keys.
unresolved_by_design: HINT_SEEN_BRANCH has a source markup discrepancy (EN 3 vs KO 4 tags); requires loader-context validation.
Original duplicate English keys must be evaluated against real loader precedence.
260 extra KO keys require reachability/version classification and should not be auto-deleted.

p0_translation_batch.description: Initial 59 literal patterns/62 locations followed by further god, summoning, beam, player, inventory and monster messages; dynamic English conjugation removed at selected callsites.
p0_translation_batch.note: Complete translated-unit count unmeasured; direct-output candidate changes measure an audit class, not complete translation coverage.

gameplay_database.next: Character speech, monster spells and weapon noises: monspeak 730 keys, monspell 260 keys, wpnnoise 65 keys; other DB partial Korean must be preserved.

coverage_policy: Never infer whole-game translation percentage from description-key correspondence or lexical inventory counts.
